tasks.spec:
You are a factory engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model (not `claude`, not `codex`), NEVER use the network, never run `python -m bench run`, never write factory/state/. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff (python files only): `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` / `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 <files>`. Tests must be hermetic (fake runner, no network, no real `claude`). Shared code must stay story-agnostic (no story, scene or character names in production code). If an OLD test pins behaviour this change deliberately changes, update it and say so in NOTES.txt. Write NOTES.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice. Read first: AGENTS.md and docs/contributor-guide.md. You may edit ONLY: factory/turn_telemetry.py (new), tests/test_turn_telemetry.py (new) and tests/shard_durations.json (one entry for the new test file, same format as its neighbours, value 2.0). Do NOT edit storygame/, frontend/ or any existing file. Nothing else.

BACKGROUND. factory/outcome_contract.py::classify_run(run, scene) (read it, tests/fixtures/outcome_contract/README.md and tests/test_outcome_contract.py FIRST; do not edit them) classifies a run. Each turn dict needs: turn, input, text, outcome, rejected, game_break, story_complete, grounding_ids, null_grounding_ids, committed_facts, candidates_offered, matched_candidate, transition_cause, pressure_event, npc_move, ending_latched, optional recovery. Saved reports lack committed_facts, null_grounding_ids, pressure_event, npc_move, ending_latched and recovery, so every committed turn reads `unknown_telemetry`. This task builds the engine-side recorder that supplies them. Already built and committed: (a) `storygame/runtime/pacing_replay.py::replay_pacing(engine) -> PacingReplay(fired_event_ids, null_grounding_ids)`: run it on the engine BEFORE the turn; it reports the pacing events a do-nothing turn would fire and the knowledge they deliver, without touching the engine; (b) `factory/contract_scene.py::build_contract_scene(package, scene_id)` builds the contract's `scene` dict; (c) the engine's per-turn `engine.last_attempt` (an AttemptBundle, storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py) holds `outcome`, `committed_delta.fact_predicates`, `transition_cause`, `story_complete`, `selected_reveal.knowledge_ids`, `reveal_selection.matched` and `.shortlist_ids`; the hosted payload and frontend/e2e/blind-player.js `turnLog` show how `candidates_offered` (shortlist ids plus the matched id) and `matched_candidate` are derived from `reveal_selection` (read turnLog, do not edit it).

BUILD factory/turn_telemetry.py (story-agnostic, standard library plus existing storygame imports only, no model call, pure apart from reading its arguments). One public function: `build_turn_telemetry(*, turn: int, player_input: str, text: str, bundle: dict, grounding_ids: list[str], replay_fired_ids, null_grounding_ids, fired_before, fired_after, pacing_effects: dict[str, list[str]], delivered_before=frozenset()) -> dict` returning one contract turn dict plus a `grounding_source` object. Rules:
- `bundle` is `AttemptBundle.model_dump(mode='json')`. `outcome` comes from bundle['outcome']; `rejected` is true when outcome is 'rejected'; `game_break` is null unless outcome is 'game_break' (then an object {outcome: 'game_break'}); `story_complete` and `transition_cause` come from the bundle.
- `committed_facts`: bundle['committed_delta']['fact_predicates'] MINUS the effect fact ids (`pacing_effects[event_id]`) of every pacing event that is in `fired_after` but not in `fired_before` (a clock event's own facts are not the player's world change). A list, possibly empty, never null for a committed turn.
- `null_grounding_ids`: exactly the list given (from the replay), a list, never null.
- `pressure_event`: true when at least one pacing event is in `fired_after` and not in `fired_before`.
- `ending_latched`: the bundle's story_complete. `npc_move`: false and `recovery`: omitted. The engine records no NPC-move or recovery signal today; say so in a module docstring so nobody mistakes the false for a measurement.
- `candidates_offered`: unique shortlist_ids from reveal_selection, plus its `matched` id if absent; `matched_candidate`: reveal_selection['matched'] or null (reveal_selection may be null).
- `grounding_source`: a dict id -> one of 'command_match' (the id equals matched_candidate), 'pacing' (in null_grounding_ids), 're_grounded' (in delivered_before), 'narrator_selection' (anything else), checked in that order.
Also provide `pacing_effects_by_event(package) -> dict[str, list[str]]` returning each package pacing event's effect fact ids (sorted lists).

TESTS, WRITE THEM FIRST in tests/test_turn_telemetry.py (hermetic; no network, no model; follow tests/test_pacing_replay.py and tests/test_trailing_pacing_events.py for building a RuntimeEngine on the real package with a fake provider; read them first): (1) pure unit cases on hand-written bundle dicts: committed_facts subtracts the effects of a newly fired pacing event but keeps the command's own facts; a fact set by an event that fired in an EARLIER turn stays out of this turn's subtraction question (only newly fired events are subtracted); pressure_event true/false from the fired sets; candidates_offered de-duplicates and adds the matched id; reveal_selection null gives candidates_offered [] and matched_candidate null; each grounding_source category including the check order; a rejected bundle gives rejected true; a game_break bundle gives a game_break object; (2) ROUND TRIP: drive a real engine for three or four turns of one scene with the fake provider (a no-effect command each turn is enough); before each turn call `replay_pacing(engine)`, snapshot `fired_before` from `engine.state.fired_event_ids` restricted to package pacing event ids, run the turn, read `engine.last_attempt.model_dump(mode='json')`, `fired_after`, and the turn's grounding ids from the turn result's segments (find how tests/test_trailing_pacing_events.py or the engine returns segments; use `[]` if the fake provider grounds nothing); build each turn record with `build_turn_telemetry`; assemble `{'replicate': 1, 'entry_facts': [], 'turns': [...]}` and call `classify_run(run, build_contract_scene(package, scene_id))`; assert no turn has action_outcome `unknown_telemetry` and the result has no key whose value reports unresolved telemetry (read classify_run's output shape); (3) the same round trip on a scene turn where a pacing event fires: that turn's `pressure_event` is true, the event's effect facts are NOT in its `committed_facts`, and `null_grounding_ids` equals the replay's (use a package copy where the event has `delivers` if the real package has none declared yet; derive it with pydantic `model_copy(update=...)`); (4) JSON serialisable output and determinism.
Run the tests plus tests/test_outcome_contract.py, tests/test_contract_scene.py and tests/test_pacing_replay.py.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-29d
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git reset -q
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(factory/turn_telemetry\.py|tests/test_turn_telemetry\.py|tests/shard_durations\.json)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -n 4 tests/test_turn_telemetry.py tests/test_outcome_contract.py tests/test_contract_scene.py tests/test_pacing_replay.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
echo "$out" | tail -6
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 240 s)"
[ "$took" -le 240 ] || { echo "over the 240 s budget"; exit 1; }
case "$out" in *skipped*) echo "tests were skipped"; exit 1;; esac
grep -q '"tests/test_turn_telemetry.py"' tests/shard_durations.json || { echo "tests/shard_durations.json lacks the new test file"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m json.tool tests/shard_durations.json > /dev/null
grep -nE "k_sl_|k_scene_|k_bridge|SL-[0-9]|\b[123][A-C]\b|inspection|kristin" factory/turn_telemetry.py && { echo "story-specific names in production code"; exit 1; } || true
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/turn-telemetry.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/turn-telemetry.patch"
